isPersonMentionedByName.description: Indicates whether the coverage group is insured voluntarily or compulsorily.

payrolls.description: Information on the insured UVGO wage sums for the coverage group, sorted in ascending order by year. The information includes data for the current year and at least the six preceding years, where available.

payrollOA.description: Total wages for occupational disability insurance.

payrollNOA.description: Total wages for non-occupational disability insurance.
